scope: Follow-up to 40 game-specific Luau files: GitHub clone/history, no Pastefy, no site APIs used to obtain Lua; 7 actual protected inputs recovered and 8 MIT source files.
validation: Pinned upstream Git commits and original SHA-256, original MIT notices copied verbatim; local protected Lua never executed as a Roblox script.
prostone4/Prometheus-Deobfuscator statically recovered 6 WAD inputs; edwindev-spec/MoonVeil recovered one v1.4.5 VM and matched 305 isolated proxy events.
All 15 published Lua syntactically compiled with luau-compile --null (Luau commit 9d7748a4f324213a18cb8283fa2a77c330225fa0). No Roblox runtime/remote claims.
